patch_description: This crossover keeps the current implementation’s endpoint-pressure signal and direct-demand emphasis, while borrowing the inspiration program’s concave demand response and transit-load adjustment. Two-hop rewards are discounted for busy transit nodes and pressured constituent links, then capped per origin-destination pair so the accumulated indirect reward cannot overwhelm the direct-link signal as network size grows. It emits at most one quadratic term per valid two-hop path, within the required term limit.
